interpretation: Matched protocol, not universally parameter/compute matched. Shared retains original packing/trimmer; layerwise retains historical confirmation path.

aggregation.uncertainty: Sample standard deviation across three training seeds (ddof=1), not a confidence interval
aggregation.accuracy: 100 times per-seed accuracy; arithmetic mean and sample SD across seeds
aggregation.macro_ovr_auroc: 100 times unweighted mean of all 10 class OvR AUROCs within each seed, then mean and sample SD across seeds
aggregation.overview_gain: Difference of configuration and S-S means, in percentage points
aggregation.rejection: Arithmetic mean and sample SD of per-seed QCD rejection only when all three seeds have nonzero QCD counts
aggregation.rejection_gain: 100 times (configuration mean rejection / S-S mean rejection - 1); not mean per-seed percentage gain
aggregation.zero_background: ZB k/3: k seeds have zero accepted QCD events; no aggregate finite rejection, SD, or gain is reported

source_metric_policy.ECE: original float64 15-bin top-label ECE; [left,right), final bin right-inclusive; empty=0
source_metric_policy.ROC: original logit_s-logit_QCD, ceil rank, >= threshold; global not shard-averaged
source_metric_policy.accuracy_bootstrap: class-stratified paired event resampling via sufficient-category multinomial counts
source_metric_policy.bootstrap_note: same sampling distribution as event bootstrap, not same draws as original campaign
source_metric_policy.bootstrap_rng: numpy.Generator(PCG64); same seed reset for each comparison
source_metric_policy.rejection_interval: 95% Wilson binomial interval conditional on empirical signal threshold; threshold uncertainty excluded
source_metric_policy.zero_background: null rejection with infinite-empirical flag and conditional Wilson bound

supplementary_30_percent.omission_reason: All completed configurations have zero accepted QCD events for these classes at 30%; original measurements remain in rejection data
